{{Quote|At last. All right, I can tell you now: I've finally delivered the secret formula for new improved Slipthroat Grizmallt Liquor! 'If it's Grizmallt, it slips down your throat.' The local bottling operation thanks you!|An individual to a spacer who helped escort them to safety|<ref name="SWG" />}}
'''Slipthroat Grizmallt Liquor''' was an [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverage from<ref name="SWG" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Grizmallt/Legends|Grizmallt]]. Sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], an [[Unidentified individual (Slipthroat Grizmallt Liquor)|individual]] developed a new secret formula for the [[Liquor/Legends|liquor]] and undertook a journey to deliver it, during which all of the individual's companions were [[Death/Legends|killed]].<ref name="SWG" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
As they neared their destination, the individual encountered a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] and requested their assistance, needing someone capable of handling a [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]] to survive the journey. The spacer agreed to accompany them, escorting the individual through significant danger, all while the individual did not divulge their possession of the formula. After successfully reaching their destination, the individual revealed to the spacer that they had transported the new Slipthroat Grizmallt Liquor formula, thanking them on behalf of a local bottling business.<ref name="SWG" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Slipthroat Grizmallt Liquor was mentioned in an escort mission assigned by a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in [[Sony]] Online Entertainment's [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its shutdown in [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The mission containing the beverage's mention could be randomly generated across several different [[Planet/Legends|planets]].<ref name="SWG" />
